bit-by-bit: To request a commission, just send me a DM on Discord or Twitter (nait0001 on both)!
The payment negotiation is very simple: you describe what you want, and based on that, I'll provide a price estimate and delivery timeframe.
If you'd like, we can hop on a call to check the project's progress.
important: Bug fixes, obviously, are free of charge.
I always ask for permission before showcasing finished commission projects in my portfolio.
No refunds if you are unsatisfied with the final project.
If you post it yourself, please make sure to give me credit.
